info.title: D2G Backend API Documentation
info.description:
API documentation organized by websource. Each websource has its own folder with relevant APIs.
- DailyDoseGoods (d2g_retail): Retail website APIs
- D8Flight (d8_flight): D8 Flight website APIs
- PetsBotanicals (pets_botanicals): Pets Botanicals website APIs
- ThinkBotanicals (think_botanicals): Think Botanicals website APIs
- Wholesale (d2g_wholesale): Wholesale website APIs
